gate4.acceptance_rule: Observed-only positive lead only if all 26 frozen canonical pages have 629/629 daily rows, all 50 eligible common-stock baseline trades join with source day plus three calendar days on or before entry, pooled positive and non-positive groups each have at least 10 trades and each window has at least 3 per group, pooled positive-minus-non-positive mean pnl_pct_net is positive, pooled Spearman is positive, and the mean difference is positive in at least two of three windows. Any failure is observed_only_rejected. A full pass is only observed_only_positive_lead_not_promoted and requires timestamped forward snapshots before any policy test.
gate4.promotion_boundary: A positive scout requires timestamped daily snapshots and new settled forward rows before a policy test.

source_manifest.historical_availability_limit: The API documents normal next-period loading but exposes no historical per-day load timestamps. The three-day lag is conservative, not audit-grade proof.
